# Vidmark 1.4.3
- Renders Markdown in chapter lessons and generated study guides, including clickable citations, headings, lists, code blocks, and tables. - Styles course content for light and dark themes, with scrollable wide tables and code blocks. - Keeps shared content safe: raw HTML and non-web links are blocked, and remote images open only when clicked. - Preserves saved course content, notes, and provider preferences.

# Vidmark 1.4.2
- Fixes provider names and status text that were difficult to read in dark mode. - Uses a white OpenAI logo in dark mode while preserving Claude's brand color. - Makes selected provider cards follow the current theme, including the in-app agent icon. - Retains the selection border and keyboard focus indicator in both themes.

# Vidmark 1.4.1
- Shows the saved AI provider and model in the sidebar; click it to open Settings. - Consolidates provider and model preferences in Settings and removes the Build tab. Start builds from the course overview. - Detects signed-in Codex and Claude Code CLIs and supports automatic model selection without a hard-coded model catalog. - Adds read-only question fact-checking with evidence and visible review status. - Supports reading-based courses, course-specific exams, and optional chapter videos. - Protects course edits and transcripts from stale or cancelled agent writes, and preserves complete question banks and review history when sharing. - Adds local debug controls and improves agent cancellation, research validation, and preference saving.
